input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment right for the Company and a consent gate (with competitor bar) on HDI assignment; confirm no HDI right arises on a Company change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 currently only binds successors and assigns and leaves assignment wholly unrestricted, so HDI could transfer this hosting engagement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. We have confirmed our right to assign to an affiliate or transaction successor and added a reasonableness-qualified consent gate on HDI assignments, together with confirmation that a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. No change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
